name: Monitor Amazon Alexa Shopping Share of Voice with Pangolinfo

parameters.content:
## Amazon Alexa Shopping share-of-voice monitor

Run up to five shopping prompts through Amazon Alexa, normalize recommended products, measure target-brand and target-ASIN presence, and alert when conversational commerce visibility falls below a threshold.

### Business outcome
- Audit several product-discovery prompts in one request
- Measure brand and ASIN recommendation coverage
- Capture competing products and follow-up questions
- Create an Alexa/AEO visibility report

This template requires self-hosted n8n with the `n8n-nodes-pangolinfo` community node enabled.

[Product page](https://www.pangolinfo.com/amazon-alexa-api/) · [API documentation](https://docs.pangolinfo.com/en-api-reference/amazonAlexaAPI/amazonAlexaAPI)

## 1. Configure the monitor

Edit only **Monitoring Configuration**. Replace all sample identifiers, thresholds, marketplace settings, and email addresses. Select a Pangolinfo credential on the orange node.

Use **Test Workflow Manually** first. Activate the daily schedule only after the output matches your monitoring goal.

## 2. Collect and analyze

**Prepare Monitoring Jobs** validates the input and creates bounded API jobs. **Ask Amazon Alexa** retrieves current structured data. **Analyze Current Data** normalizes response variations, calculates the use-case metrics, and records human-readable alert reasons.

## 3. Aggregate and alert

**Build Monitoring Report** produces one Markdown portfolio report. Only failed thresholds reach **Email Monitoring Alert**; healthy executions still return a structured summary.

Connect SMTP or replace the final alert node with Slack, Teams, Jira, a database, or a data warehouse.

parameters.jsCode: const config = $json; const prompts = String(config.prompts ?? '').split(/[\s,]+/).map((v) => v.trim().toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean); return [{ json: { ...config, prompts, trackedAsins, monitorKey: config.trackedBrand } }];
